text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as the debut race was steadily 
drawing closer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff...! Uphill training complete!
choice_data_list:
Good work. Alright, take a 10-minute 
break!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Oh, that reminds me, can I take a 
look at the opponent data during our 
break? It arrived this morning, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I need to make sure I memorize everything 
about all the rivals I'll be facing in my 
debut race...
choice_data_list: It's on the tablet, if that's okay...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the one on top of the bench. Got it! 
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you notice anything, please let me 
consult with you during our next meeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In terms of condition, she's doing very 
well. To begin with, she has always had 
extraordinary potential when it comes to 
speed, and—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it's her sheer dedication. She 
follows instructions to the letter, and on 
top of that, she's constantly seeking ways 
to grow stronger on her own.
choice_data_list: (That's exactly why, it's just—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A bit frustrating. Such a feeling had 
begun to sprout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I must do more for K.S. Miracle. So that 
she can fulfill her dreams while running 
happily and full of life—"
choice_data_list: (Isn't there more I can do for her?)

(Isn't there anything more I can do for 
her?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
—Other than that, nutrition remains an 
issue. It's improved considerably compared 
to childhood, but for an athlete, that 
appetite is simply far too small.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"If eating large portions at once is 
difficult, splitting them into smaller 
meals is an option. In other words—"
choice_data_list: Predation, indeed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nutritional meals taken before and after 
exercise, separate from breakfast, lunch, 
and dinner. How about we actively have 
them consume those—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked the doctor about K.S.Miracle 
before, that kind of topic came up.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's make it! A nutritious 
snack...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The key nutrients when it comes to 
supplemental snacks are carbohydrates for 
energy, followed by vitamins and minerals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And if we are to eat it anyway, I would 
want it to be something enjoyable. Perhaps 
by including our favorite foods..."
choice_data_list: In that case, the menu will be—!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Trainer, did you make this fruit 
mousse yourself from scratch...!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, well... oh, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I added that she didn't have to force 
herself to eat. That was because...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was entirely different from her usual 
haphazard home cooking. Her determined 
over-cautiousness backfired 
spectacularly... and the end result was 
fairly disastrous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I intended to make a mousse, but it 
wouldn't set properly at all, ending up 
looking like a half-melted milkshake...
choice_data_list:
...On second thought, I'll take it home! 
Sorry—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...I'm sorry, I already ate it.
choice_data_list: Huh, already!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly... Hehe, I'm sorry. It was just 
so delicious, I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because it was on the softer side, it was 
actually easier to swallow... It might've 
been just right for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, it was a real surprise! The fruit 
inside, like the bananas... it was packed 
full of all my favorites."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All my training fatigue just blew right 
away... Trainer, your homemade cooking is 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aren't other people praising you for how 
amazing it is too?
choice_data_list: Huh, the others?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
No, I'm not really the type to make 
handmade stuff for someone else...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-Is that so? I'm sorry, I just 
assumed... it was because it was your 
hobby...
choice_data_list:
Not at all! This is the first time I've 
ever made something like this

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First time...? Huh... But, if that's the 
case... umm.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: I hope it helps you get some nutrients

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Ever since... Ever since I 
met you—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm always being caught off 
guard by how kind you are.
choice_data_list: (..."Kindness", huh?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer... You're so much more than I 
ever imagined—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You've always, always... been so kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, K.S. Miracle said 
something similar when we signed our 
trainer contract.
choice_data_list:
(Still, is this really "kindness," or 
rather...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something's bothering me. However... I 
can't quite put it into words.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I'm completely back on my 
feet. Thank you very much. I'll keep 
working hard toward my debut tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I promise I won't let your thoughtfulness 
go to waste, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, see you tomorrow.
...Yeah, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, seeing her brave smile left me 
with no other choice but to respond that 
way.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...It's finally here.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Once we leave the inn, all that's left... 
is to head straight to Niigata 
Racecourse.)
choice_data_list:
Miracle. Will you be able to head out 
soon?
Miracle. Can you head out soon?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm ready. Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It's finally starting... my debut 
race...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nonononononooo~!! Are we still gonna make 
it in time for Mira-pi's Make Debut!? Can 
we still make it!? Are we closer to 'yes' 
or 'totally screwed'!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! Helios gets way too caught up 
chatting with every single person she runs 
into!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, but Niigata Racecourse isn't that 
far from here! If we haul it full speed 
down the Umamusume Lane, we'll make it 
easily!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is a favorable wind indeed. Come, let 
us all become the gale and set forth—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
By the way... is Ruby-san unable to make 
it after all?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! Super sad face~!! All she 
replied was, "I must decline as my 
schedule is uncertain," though~...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, she is a pretty busy girl, after 
all. Now that she's moved up to the 
Classic Class, I bet things have been 
extra hectic lately.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see... Caught in rough seas, are they? 
If so, it cannot be helped...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then we just gotta cheer all the harder to 
make up for Ruby, su!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's roll!! Destination: Niigata 
Racecourse!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the "Make Debut" race starting 
shortly, as for K.S. Miracle—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: Th-that confident smile...!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not true... I'm nervous, super 
nervous, really.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, though…… I'm just so happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I really... made it all the way here, 
didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Compared to back then... when I was lying 
in bed all the time, it feels completely 
unimaginable.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eating plenty, and training every day 
together with Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With legs that were never supposed to move 
again, now I can run around so freely and 
fast.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Today, at long last. On the ultimate 
racing stage— the Twinkle Series— I am 
about to make my debut.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's an amazing feat. Truly... an 
incredible miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle spoke as if savoring each 
word, and then lightly tapped her chest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, yeah. More than nervous—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, but my desire to do my 
absolute best is way stronger.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do my best. ...I'm off!
